name: Dayforce
summary: Dayforce sells compensation management inside its HR and payroll suite. Its compensation page describes awarding merit, bonus and equity under pre-defined rules, pay equity graphs and pay-equity analysis, and flags increases that fall outside range. The page publishes no prices and offers a demo or a sales call.

facts.text: The compensation page says Dayforce lets organizations 'Award merit, bonus, and equity to eligible employees based on pre-defined rules.'
The page says organizations can 'Identify whether your organization has a gender pay gap with pay equity graphs.'
The compliance section says the product can 'highlight increases that are out of range.'
A customer testimonial on the page describes comparing current pay with the salary band for each job.
The page's FAQ lists pay-equity analysis and guardrails next to market benchmarking as features to consider.

plans.name: Compensation management (quote only)
plans.notes: The compensation page shows no prices. Its buttons read Request a demo, Talk to Sales and Schedule a Demo, and it has no quote wording. The quote basis is not stated.

hiddenCosts: No price, currency or billing period is published on the compensation page.
